structural_change: L2H-HC 10-19 (H.STA.BLK.1): successor of hbm_hc_root_d4g_xr (route r1-88f1fa301 crashed twice in macro_place.tcl 'expected 1 macros, netlist has 2'). The root has TWO ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256 macros: u_tbl (bases/scales table) and u_seq.u_program (HC event programme); the kit now names both instances explicitly on the 43.2 um lattice, side by side at mid-height (programme x86.4, table x388.8, y302.4; 127.7 um channel between their pin faces, 86.4/84.5 um to W/E), W/E pin-face halo 10.8 um (macro_halo_x_um) for the native 57 contacts/5.4 um faces; io_hold_margin 0.03. Same RTL/params/pins/outline as xr. HC-XRDU 10-18 (RELEASE_TREE H.STA.WIRE.8): the d4g HC root hbm_hc_root_d4g with the LANDED root <-> quarter-hub latency compiled in: XRD 11 / XRU 11 (compiler constants = per-quarter maxima) and per-quarter XRDQ = SW/SE/NW/NE 11/6/11/6 (32'h060b060b), XRUQ = 11/7/10/5 (32'h050a070b), derived by tools/hbm_die_v16/d4g_hc_xr.py from the GEN2 landed smoke contract (landed lane latency ceil(N/2) + 1 + E from each landing's K strap; N = 17/7/18/8 down, 18/9/16/5 up). The root pads quarter q by XRD - XRDQ[q] stages before its qd/qi out flops and XRU - XRUQ[q] after its qps/q_fault/gathered-mix pin flops (ot_hdc_delay, 65 + 76 b per quarter, max 5 stages), so every quarter runs on one compiled timeline (RAW0 167 + 22 = 189, ingest lead 13). Same RTL/ports/outline/pins as hbm_hc_root_d4g; only the four parameters differ. Re-derive (and re-kit) when the GEN2 stations replace the smoke stations (root moves to the centre slot): l7_wire.py applies d4g_hc_xr.py to the landed contract.
